owner_calls.question: In X-Men (2000) Mystique has long been posing as Henry Gyrich, Senator Kelly's aide (Magneto: Gyrich 'has been dead for quite some time'). After Kelly dies she poses as Kelly himself on TV, and in X2 she is still posing as Kelly to get at Magneto's prison. Does this count as undercover service in the U.S. Senate (the group the app gives Kelly), like Natasha as Natalie Rushman? If so, how is it staged alongside the Brotherhood, which she never leaves?
options: Keep as is (impersonation for a Brotherhood plot, not service in the Senate)
Add U.S. Senate: [["The Brotherhood","X-Men (2000)"],["U.S. Senate","X-Men (2000)"],["The Brotherhood","X2"],["Independent","X-Men: The Last Stand"]], keeping the X-Men: The Last Stand left title
owner_calls.evidence: X-Men (2000): she poses as Kelly's aide Henry Gyrich to kidnap Kelly, and at the end she appears on TV as Kelly to withdraw his support for the Mutant Registration Act. X2: she 'has been using her powers to pose as Senator Robert Kelly as a means to gain access to Magneto's plastic prison' (the record's own Senator Kelly X2 step: she joins Stryker's meeting with the President as Kelly).
